data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element.

levels.name: Shadow Xs
levels.description: Extra small shadow with 5% black opacity and 2px blur. Used for subtle elevation on small elements.

levels.name: Shadow Sm
levels.description: Small shadow with dual layers - 4% black opacity at 2px and 8px blur. Provides soft elevation for cards and containers.

levels.name: Shadow Md
levels.description: Medium shadow with 10% black opacity, 6px and 4px blur with negative offsets. Standard elevation for interactive elements.

levels.name: Shadow Lg
levels.description: Large shadow with 10% black opacity, 15px and 6px blur. Used for prominent elevated elements.

levels.name: Shadow Xl
levels.description: Extra large shadow with 10% black opacity, 25px and 10px blur. High elevation for floating elements.

levels.name: Shadow 2xl
levels.description: Double extra large shadow with 25% black opacity and 50px blur. Maximum elevation for modals and dialogs.

levels.name: Shadow Searchbar
levels.description: Custom searchbar shadow with triple layers - 6% black at 4px and 12px blur plus 1px ring. Specialized for search components.

levels.name: Shadow Dropdown
levels.description: Dropdown shadow with 4% and 8% black opacity layers at 16px and 8px blur. Used for dropdown menus and popovers.

levels.name: Shadow Modal
levels.description: Modal shadow with 4% and 6% black opacity at 12px and 40px blur. Designed for modal dialogs and overlays.

levels.name: Shadow Toast
levels.description: Toast notification shadow with 5%, 10%, and 5% black opacity layers. Includes subtle top highlight.

levels.name: Drop Shadow Md
levels.description: Medium drop shadow filter with 12% black opacity at 3px offset. Used for CSS filter effects.

levels.name: Drop Shadow Lg
levels.description: Large drop shadow filter with 15% black opacity at 4px offset. Used for CSS filter effects on larger elements.

levels.name: Tw Inset Ring Shadow
levels.description: Transparent reset shadow used as default value for Tailwind ring utilities.
